answer_1.quote: We propose a modular, multi-faceted DDx agent framework (MEDDxAgent), integrating a history taking simulator and two diagnostic agents (knowledge retrieval, diagnosis strategy), which enables extensible and explainable decision-making processes.
answer_1.outputs: ranked differential diagnoses, diagnostic reasoning, interactive patient dialogue

answer_2.quote: To evaluate diagnostic performance, we employ three metrics. First, we compute the average rank of the correct disease... Second, we use GTPA@k (Ground Truth Pathology Accuracy)... Third, we introduce a new metric suitable for the iterative setting: average progress rate (∆ Progress).
